description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams used for encapsulating search filter parameters within the Employee Directory feature of the OrangeHRM system. The class extends a base FilterParams class, holds properties for various search criteria, and provides getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters such as employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID for querying the Employee Directory.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers as an array or null.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID string used for filtering.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.
